evidence.actual: The user is not assigned to this application.

output.fix: The IdP refused the request because the user is not assigned to this application. Assign the user (or a group they belong to) to the SP application in the IdP, then retry the login. Issuer, Destination and InResponseTo all match, so no SP-side change is needed. Keep signature validation on. Because this is an error response with no assertion, the signature, audience, time-window, NameID and attribute checks were skipped. Re-run the diagnosis on a successful response after the assignment is fixed.

alternatives.why_not: The deterministic top cause is the non-Success status. The refusal reason is carried in the status sub-code and message, so the status class fits better.
